book.name: 1 Timothy
book.title: 1 Timothy Saint Paul Tr'ookit Timothy ts'ą' Ch'adąąntł'oo

content: Khaiinkǫǫ drin zhit ji', dinjii lat nąįį gwik'iinjigiighit ąįįtł'ęę akhagagooheenjyaa gwinyąą ąįįt'ee Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą gwinzii gwizhrįh nigwiin'ąįį ts'ą' geeginkhe'. Ch'anky'aa oots'it ąįį zhit neegeheedaa ts'ą' ch'anky'aa iizųų ąįį k'iinjigiheedhaa.
Gwik'iinjiighit adaa'įį ts'ą' oots'it nąįį ts'an tr'idigweheedhaa, ąįįts'ą' gooyinji' iłchįį, ch'iitsii niindhaa haa dhik'in gwik'it.

Ąįį k'it t'inchy'aa dinjii veegwarąhchįį chan ts'ą' shih lat tr'ihee'aa gwiizųų ginyąą. Gaa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa shih tr'ihee'aa eenjit yiłtsąįį, yak'aa khadigeedi' ts'ą' yeenjit mahsį' diinyą', ąįį juu gwik'iinjigweeghit di'įį ts'ą' łi'didlii haandaii nąįį yihee'aa eenjit.
Jidii Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa yiłtsąįį datthak nizįį, ch'ihłak gaa duuyeh itr'igwii'ee, gaa datthak geenjit mahsį' gweheenjyaa ts'ą' khadigireheejyaa.
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik chan ts'ą' khadigiriinjii haa nihłaa shroodiinyąą ilik.

Nachaa nąįį jii deeni'in naihnyąą datthak gwik'it t'ini'in ji' łyaa Christ Jesus vitsyaa nizįį hinlyaa, gwik'iinjigwiighit ginjik eenjit adagwan'ee ts'ą' Gwandak Nizįį chan khit ts'ą' gwinzii eech'ǫąąhtan gwantą' gwik'it.
Gaa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vinehts'į' gwandak ginilih kwaa kwaii ts'į' adak'ǫǫntii. Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vik'it gwihiindaii ąįį khit gwik'it t'iinchy'aa.

Gwitr'it haa nat'aii gwahtsii ąįį gwinzii gaa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa doo'ya' diinoonyąą ąįį gwik'it t'igwii'in ąįįt'ee łyaa khit ts'ą' gwinzii, ąįįt'ee juk gwarandaii akwat yeendaa gwireheendaii gwizhit deeshi'yaa nyąą gwik'it t'iizhik.
Jii jyaa digwinyąą t'ee łyaa łi'deegwidlii vik'injireheedaa goo'aii ts'ą' vit'injigwarahaahchy'aa.

Ąįį geh'an t'ee gwitr'it gogwantrii datthak geenjit gwat'aii gwitr'it t'agwarah'in. Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa khit gwandaii deehee'yaa nyąą ąįį gwik'it t'ihee'yaa ąįį gwaroontą', ąįįt'ee dinjii datthak nahshii. Ąįį juu yit'injyaahchy'aa nąįį ch'andaa gwik'iinjiighit.
Jii kwaii jyaa dohnyąą ts'ą' veech'ǫąąhtan.

K'eejit inlii geenjit nich'itsaroo'e' shrǫ', gaa nats'ąą ginkhii, deeni'in, nich'eet'igwiniindhan, nigwik'iinjigwiighit akwat nigwitr'it gwiizųų gwakwaa kwaii haa datthak gwik'iinjiighit nąįį nik'it giheedaa eenjit geegoovąąhtan.
K'ineehihdik gwats'ą' tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit k'iinaa Dęhtły'aa Choh kat ginkhii ąįį nihk'it ginkhii inlii ts'ą' geech'ǫąąhtan.

Ch'anjaa gwik'injiighit kįh dilk'ii nąįį tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit nakat nagaanjik dąį' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Eenjit Ginkhii Nąįį ąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vik'iighai' nintł'eegwin'ąįį łyaa vat'ąąhchy'aa.
Gwintł'oo jii kwaii datthak khit ts'ą' t'ini'in ts'ą' juu nąįį datthak gwinzii naageheendaii eenjit.
Adak'ąąntii ts'ą' jidii eenjit geech'ǫąąhtan ąįį gwinzii gwak'ąąhtii. Khit ts'ą' jii kwaii datthak t'ini'in, jyaa deeni'in ji' neehįįnzhii ts'ą' juu noołk'įį nąįį datthak chan neeheezhii t'oonchy'aa.
